vector_memory.semantic_summary: This module implements the core logic for a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system, utilizing ChromaDB for vector storage. It provides specialized providers, RAGChromaDBProvider and RAGEmbeddingProvider, to manage the ingestion pipeline. Key functions like ingest_text handle text chunking, embedding generation via Sentence Transformers, and deterministic upserting into the database. retrieve_context performs similarity searches, applying score and token limits for efficient context retrieval.
